title: Rydberg states of alkali atoms in atomic vapour as SI-traceable field probes and communications receivers
abstract: Technical Review covering the current state of Rydberg atom-based electrometry in room-temperature atomic vapours. Covers EIT/Autler-Townes readout, SI-traceable self-calibrated E-field measurements, sensitivity floor ~270 uV/m/sqrt(Hz) over 2-5 GHz, DC-to-THz spectral coverage, waveguide-coupled implementations, and communications receiver demonstrations.
key_claims: Sensitivity of 270 uV/m/sqrt(Hz) maintained across 2-5 GHz
SI-traceable self-calibrated measurement with >10x improvement over classical antenna standards at 0.1% precision
EIT-based readout converts RF to optical domain without traditional antennas
Coverage from DC to THz with a single vapor cell
Waveguide-coupled variant demonstrated for near-field antenna measurement (0-20 GHz)
